title: Unas
description: Last king of Egypt's Dynasty 5. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (1715 to 1682 BC). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "Unas Famine matches Senusret I Famine"
reign.note: His 33-year reign counted from Dynasty 6's 203 years before the death of Nitocris in 1479 BC; it overlaps Joseph's famine.

reign.date: Start Co-Rex: 1732; Start Sole-rex: 1716; End Sole-rex: 1682; Death or Deposition: 1682
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7B: Kings of Dynasties 1-13," OSF preprint v1.3 (10 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/TUWNC, file CFAH 7-B Kings of Dynasties 1-13_v_1.3.pdf, Table 12 "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 5", p. 100
